ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
<image> In $\odot Z, P Z=Z Q$, $X Y=4 a-5,$ and $S T=-5 a+13$
Find $S Q$
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended problem

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a circle with Z as the center. Inside the circle there is an upper chord XY, point P is on chord XY, segment ZP connects from center Z to P, and a right angle is marked at P in the figure, indicating ZP ⟂ XY. Inside the circle there is also an oblique chord ST, point Q is on chord ST, segment ZQ connects from center Z to Q, and a right angle is marked at Q in the figure, indicating ZQ ⟂ ST. Reasoning: It is known that PZ = ZQ, therefore the perpendicular distances from the two chords XY and ST to center Z are equal. Chords in a circle that are at equal distances from the center are equal, so XY = ST. Given in the problem XY = 4a - 5 and ST = -5a + 13, we can get 4a - 5 = -5a + 13. Solving gives 9a = 18, so a = 2. Thus ST = -5(2) + 13 = 3. Also because the perpendicular from the center of a circle to a chord bisects the chord, Q is the midpoint of ST, SQ = ST/2 = 3/2 = 1.5.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at Z with two chords, XY and ST. The segment ZP is drawn perpendicular to chord XY at P, and ZQ is drawn perpendicular to chord ST at Q, as indicated by the right-angle marks. From the text, use PZ = ZQ, XY = 4a - 5, and ST = -5a + 13. Apply the theorem: chords equidistant from the center of a circle are congruent. Thus XY = ST, so 4a - 5 = -5a + 13, giving a = 2. Then ST = -5(2) + 13 = 3. Since a perpendicular from the center to a chord bisects the chord, Q is the midpoint of ST, so SQ = ST/2 = 1.5.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图显示一个以 Z 为圆心的圆。圆内有上方弦 XY，点 P 在弦 XY 上，线段 ZP 从圆心 Z 连到 P，并且图中在 P 处标有直角，表示 ZP ⟂ XY。圆内还有斜弦 ST，点 Q 在弦 ST 上，线段 ZQ 从圆心 Z 连到 Q，并且图中在 Q 处标有直角，表示 ZQ ⟂ ST。
推理：已知 PZ = ZQ，因此两条弦 XY 和 ST 到圆心 Z 的垂直距离相等。圆中到圆心距离相等的弦相等，所以 XY = ST。由题给 XY = 4a - 5，ST = -5a + 13，可得 4a - 5 = -5a + 13。解得 9a = 18，所以 a = 2。于是 ST = -5(2) + 13 = 3。又因为圆心到弦的垂线平分弦，所以 Q 是 ST 的中点，SQ = ST/2 = 3/2 = 1.5。

method.method_draft: Read the diagram by focusing on right triangles formed inside the circle: triangle ZPX uses radius ZX or ZY to chord XY, and triangle ZQS uses radius ZS or ZT to chord ST. The right-angle marks show ZP ⟂ XY and ZQ ⟂ ST. Because Z is the center, ZX and ZS are radii and are equal. The text gives PZ = ZQ. Therefore right triangles ZPX and ZQS are congruent by hypotenuse-leg, so XP = SQ. Also, since the perpendicular from the center to a chord bisects the chord, XP = XY/2 and SQ = ST/2. Thus XY and ST must be equal, so 4a - 5 = -5a + 13, giving a = 2. Then SQ = ST/2 = (-5(2) + 13)/2 = 3/2 = 1.5.

图像描述：图中是以 Z 为圆心的圆。上方有弦 XY，点 P 在弦 XY 上，线段 ZP 垂直于 XY，旁边有直角标记。左下到下方有弦 ST，点 Q 在弦 ST 上，线段 ZQ 垂直于 ST，也有直角标记。Z 到圆上的点 X、S 等都是半径。

推理：因为 Z 是圆心，所以 ZX 和 ZS 都是半径，故 ZX = ZS。题目给出 PZ = ZQ。又由图中直角标记可知 △ZPX 和 △ZQS 都是直角三角形，因此它们由斜边和一条直角边相等可得全等，所以 XP = SQ。另一方面，圆心到弦的垂线平分弦，所以 XP = XY/2，SQ = ST/2。由 XP = SQ 可得 XY/2 = ST/2，因此 XY = ST。代入 XY = 4a - 5，ST = -5a + 13：4a - 5 = -5a + 13，解得 9a = 18，a = 2。于是 ST = -5(2) + 13 = 3，所以 SQ = ST/2 = 3/2 = 1.5。
